offline_gate.source: main thread, blind frozen active90, confirmed before deployment

order: rotate C/N/L, N/L/C, L/C/N by pair ordinal; six first, then unused indices ascending, without replacement
factor: Only override a native below-.8 deferral after two successive measured single-open samples of the same unfinished head, with a real successor, when f + max(0,f-prev_f) >= .8. Widen only the next forward. Reset history on head change or any dual slot. No-op executes instrumentation but never overrides.
gate: No selection by correctness. Six controls exactly match the sealed compact trajectories; six no-ops match controls including decisions, layer widths and output. At least one real new admission in six. Identical paid history through the deciding tick; next forward differs only by admitting its successor (same head tokens). All 20 layers match 32/64 projected rows, prefill separate, all requests terminate under upstream accounting. Fail closed before extension if gate fails. Same checks across the 90. Keep ineligible identities.
metrics: Per-request N/F/Q/score, actual admission count/first admission, final IDs, macro TPF, pooled TE, original30/new60/full90. Additional admissions are not saved calls.
